explanation: Phil Collins played both concerts on the same day, flying from London to the US on Concorde between his two sets. The shows raised money for famine relief in Ethiopia.

claims.text: On 13 July 1985, Live Aid was held at Wembley Stadium in London and at John F. Kennedy Stadium in Philadelphia.
Live Aid's US concert was not held in New York City, Los Angeles or Chicago.
On 13 July 1985 Phil Collins performed at both Live Aid concerts, crossing the Atlantic on Concorde between his two sets.
Live Aid raised money for relief of the famine in Ethiopia.
